freeze_rule: Statements and falsifiers frozen before fresh literature pressure. Entry-known P38 prior art remains declared background.

seeds.statement: For a finite candidate-model class and frozen intervention set I, a representation property is identifiable exactly when it is constant on every equivalence class of models with identical I-indexed observable response laws.
seeds.attack: Two models share every observable trajectory under I but assign different latent quotient/action structure.
seeds.external_change: Would require adding an observational-equivalence rival pair to an external packet.

seeds.statement: A family of prospective interventions separates every rival-model pair exactly when it hits every pairwise disagreement set; a minimum separating family is a minimum hitting set.
seeds.attack: If any rival pair has an empty disagreement set, no intervention from the frozen pool can identify it.
seeds.external_change: Would replace confirmatory checks with a minimum rival-separating intervention set.

seeds.statement: A behavioral divergence is uniquely attributable to action-coordinate geometry only relative to a rival class for which all non-action pathways are fixed and the action-geometry intervention produces a response signature absent from every rival.
seeds.attack: Construct action-geometry and history-policy models with identical response laws on all tested contexts.
seeds.external_change: Would add a policy/history-matched negative control.

seeds.statement: For two binary intervention axes, a joint-only separator requires and is witnessed by nonzero interaction contrast delta=y11-y10-y01+y00 after pure-axis effects are zero; XOR is the smallest deterministic witness.
seeds.attack: Under product-separable response y(o,a)=u(o)+v(a), delta is zero; XOR violates separability.
seeds.external_change: Would add the mixed cells needed to distinguish coupling from two pure effects.

seeds.statement: An intervention has a well-defined action on an observation quotient exactly when the observation equivalence is a congruence for that intervention; otherwise the first non-commuting fiber is a constructive falsifier.
seeds.attack: Two equivalent states are sent to different quotient classes.
seeds.external_change: Would add statewise commutation rather than aggregate output agreement.

seeds.statement: For a finite bounded decision problem with frozen action constraints, the coarsest task-sufficient observation is equality of complete admissible future-response profiles; any strict coarsening merges a prospectively distinguishable pair.
seeds.attack: Merge two states separated by one admissible word and terminal output.
seeds.external_change: Would enumerate distinguishing words rather than static labels only.

seeds.statement: An adverse-residue completeness certificate is valid only relative to an exhaustive finite domain and a declared total factor family; no finite certificate over a non-exhaustive factor family can establish that no omitted factor explains the residue.
seeds.attack: Add an unmodeled binary factor supported exactly on the certified residue without changing any modeled factor outputs.
seeds.external_change: Would force an explicit omitted-factor challenge and relative-completeness label.

seeds.statement: A frozen minimal-witness selector is representation invariant exactly when the representation bijection preserves eligibility and acts as an order automorphism of the comparator keys; without order equivariance a two-witness rank reversal is unavoidable.
seeds.attack: Swap two eligible witnesses while leaving a non-invariant total order fixed.
seeds.external_change: Would require comparator-equivariance controls in transported witness selection.
